_comment: Local-dev default only. Azure App Service Application Settings (including ConnectionStrings__VlmsDatabase) are injected as environment variables into a co-located WebJob's process automatically, same as adr/0003-scheduled-jobs-webjobs.md's 'shares the App Service plan' consequence — this file is not the production configuration source.

ConnectionStrings._comment: PostgreSQL (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure SQL Database). Local-dev default only, same status as the rest of this file per the top-level _comment above.

Safeguarding._comment: low-level-design.md calls the consent/DBS expiry warning window 'configurable'; 28 is the documented build-time default (ConsentExpiryJob.DefaultExpiryWarningWindowDays) — override here or via the equivalent Azure App Service Application Setting (Safeguarding__ExpiryWarningWindowDays) without a recompile.

Smtp._comment: PLACEHOLDER SMTP configuration (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure Communication Services Email). Sending target still undecided per the ADR (the org's existing Microsoft 365 mailbox vs. a free-tier transactional provider) — replace Host/Port/Username/Password/FromAddress with the real target's values before go-live; no real secrets belong in this file (use an environment variable / systemd EnvironmentFile instead). Backs NotificationService's real IEmailSender (Notifications/SmtpEmailSender.cs).
